about: When humans get too lonely, they turn into monsters… Set sail across a beautiful and evolving world of darkness and light, and discover what it means to be human.
Sea of Solitude embarks players on a nuanced and intimate action-adventure, where players must guide Kay through her Sea of Solitude, in this touching tale of darkness and light.
Water levels rise and fall to reflect Kay's own state of mind, transforming the flooded city landscape into new areas for the player to explore, with new challenges to face.
